landing.heroTitle: Bring customers back automatically — with your own email, WhatsApp, SMS and phone
landing.heroSubtitle: vendocas. reminds customers who went quiet, thanks those who bought and brings them back — through your own store's WhatsApp and e-mail.
landing.how1d: A customer stops buying for 3 months, abandons a checkout, misses an appointment or calls when you can’t answer.
landing.how2d: Minutes, days, business days or calendar months — in your time zone or your customer’s.
landing.how3d: Only customers who authorized the channel, didn’t buy again and weren’t contacted recently.
landing.how4d: Email, WhatsApp, SMS or a call-back task for your team — and track what really happened.
landing.examplesTitle: Examples you can build in minutes
landing.ex1: 3 months without buying → “We miss you” email with a coupon
landing.ex2: 6 months without interaction → WhatsApp template B
landing.ex3: Missed call → call-back task and, if authorized, a WhatsApp message
landing.ex4: Checkout started and no purchase in 30 min → reminder
landing.ex5: Every day at 11:00 → photo campaign to opted-in customers, within your budget
landing.channelsText: Connect your own WhatsApp Business number through Meta’s official signup, your email domain, and a phone number for SMS and missed calls. We never send on your behalf from a shared number.
landing.numberTitle: Can I keep my current number?
landing.numberText: WhatsApp: eligible WhatsApp Business App numbers can use coexistence; otherwise the number moves to the Cloud API. Phone: forward unanswered calls to your Vendocas number to detect missed calls. SMS: use a new number, or port/host an existing one where supported.
landing.campaignsText: Schedule recurring image campaigns by day and time zone, see the estimated cost before sending, cap recipients and spend, and let us pause automatically when the budget runs out.
landing.securityText: Consent per channel and purpose with evidence, one-click unsubscribe, suppression lists, data export and erasure, MFA, encrypted credentials and full audit trail. Built for LGPD, GDPR, TCPA and CAN-SPAM obligations — final compliance depends on how you use it; review with your counsel.
landing.pricingNote: Prices in USD per establishment, before taxes. Taxes are calculated at checkout. WhatsApp, SMS and calls are billed from prepaid communication credits at the rates shown in your dashboard — no plan includes unlimited messages.
landing.faq1q: Do I need to choose my business segment?
landing.faq1a: No. You define your own rules — the engine works the same for a pizzeria, a clinic or a law firm.
landing.faq2a: No. Email is included within fair-use limits; WhatsApp, SMS and calls use prepaid credits with daily and monthly spend limits you control.
landing.faq3q: Can I message any phone number I have?
landing.faq3a: No. Having a number is not permission. Promotional messages require the customer’s authorization for that channel; Vendocas blocks sends without it.
landing.faq4a: Yes, businesses can choose monthly invoicing (bank transfer, boleto, ACH or SEPA where available). Service starts after the payment is confirmed.
landing.faq5a: Anytime in Billing. Your plan stays active until the end of the paid period; your data is kept for the retention period so you can come back.
landing.ctaText: Create your account, connect email in minutes and activate your first automation.
landing.flow3: CHECK · authorized email, no new purchase
